##### Hey guys, after some discussion in my Lunaris creation thread, I've decided to take on an existing unclaimed race instead: the Candid! I would also like to expand on their story a bit and give them more relevance in an age of discovery and exploration. I wasn't sure exactly what should go in a Claim Race thread, so I'm winging it a little bit. :)

[The Candid](https://kumu.io/Phyra/ecosystem-of-gaea#gaea/candid) were created by Flox on behalf of Godric. They have been tasked with protecting travelers in the darkness; an even more crucial role in today's age of Exploration. To this end, Candid are in small packs throughout Gaea, carrying on their solemn (and often unseen) duty. Travelers need not be afraid of the dark.

Thanks to a generous blessing from Tempest, the Candid are a force to be reckoned with when on the defensive or provoked. As the tides come and go, so does the strength of the Candid. Attacking one at any point other than his or her weakest is a error that will not be made twice.

While Candid tend to carry out their duty in small packs, the tribe has agreed to designate Eclipse as their leader. Eclipse is revered throughout the tribe for his nigh-legendary wisdom and strength. One of his primary duties is communication with the rest of Gaea on behalf of the tribe. If, Gods forbid, the Candid were ever to go to war, Eclipse would be leading from the vanguard.

After much discussion, the Candid have decided to accept Pome's invitation to start a colony in the Forest of Brotherhood.

The Candid and I have similar goals (at times) in regards to the protection of the travelers upon the roads. They may have heard of Cruxius, Lord of the Crossroads, and might be of interest to him as well.

Welcome to the game! We look forward to seeing the Candid expanded upon!
